attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 28 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the page. It prints no hymn, no distich and no year, and it says itself that the memory is in neither of the two synaxaria it names; the folder is made on the strength of the day listing and the manuscript the page cites, and on nothing else. The page carries no asterisk and not the «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence, so this is not the refusal of §10 but a thin entry the site does vouch for.
